topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the course structure, learning objectives, and scope of cancer biology.

topics.label: Cellular and tissue fundamentals of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological origins of cancer as a disruption of normal differentiation, genetic regulation, and three-dimensional tissue architecture.

topics.label: Tumor invasion, metastasis, and malignant behaviour
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the pathological and clinical features that distinguish benign encapsulated tumors from invasive, metastasising malignancies.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and benign tumor pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors progress in a stepwise manner from precursor lesions to invasive disease alongside the clinical complications caused by non-malignant growths.

topics.label: Tumor classification and nomenclature conventions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and exceptions used to name benign and malignant tumors according to their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical, physiological, and systemic processes through which primary and metastatic tumors cause patient illness and death.

topics.label: Comparative cancer incidence across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare the epidemiological frequency and mortality patterns of various cancers in humans with tumor incidence across companion animals and other multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss patient presentation and evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of population screening programmes for various cancer types.

topics.label: Closing housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with a reminder of learning outcomes and upcoming practicals.
